newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish mobile phone sales to rise in '97-industry.
newsitem.headline: Swedish mobile phone sales to rise in '97-industry.

text.p: Mobile telephone sales in Sweden were forecast to rise to 1.1 million in 1997 from just over one million in 1996, an industry body said on Thursday.
The Mobile Phone Deliverers organisation (MTL) said GSM telephones would account for the majority of sales, followed by a new type of mobile telephone, the DCS 1800.
Last year, 925,000 GSM phones were sold in Sweden, said an MTL report published by national news agency TT.
Sweden has one of the highest rates in the world of mobile phones per capita with an estimated one in every four Swedes owning a mobile phone.
